name: North Point Tower
summary: North Point Tower is an isolated Theramore military outpost keeping watch over the northern roads of Dustwallow Marsh. Staffed by Theramore guards, it serves as the city-state's furthest standing watchpost against the hostile wildlands and local threats.

sections.title: A Lonely Frontier
sections.body: Perched along the northern thoroughfare of Dustwallow Marsh, North Point Tower marks the distant boundary of Theramore's military reach. Ever since deserters took over Lost Point, the guards stationed here stand as the city-state's most remote watch against the dangers of the swamp. From this stone vantage, Theramore scouts monitor road traffic, track aggressive local wildlife, and keep a wary eye on both the hostile Grimtotem tauren and the nearby Horde outpost at Brackenwall Village.

sections.title: Eyes Across the Mire
sections.body: Life at North Point is harsh and tense. The guards must defend against predatory raptors and encroaching Grimtotem raiders while securing vital intelligence for Theramore. Situated between allied territory and hostile wilderness, the garrison maintains a tenuous foothold, serving as a staging point for scouting expeditions deeper into the swamp toward reclusive figures like Tabetha.

aliases: who is at north point tower
faq.answer: North Point Tower is controlled by Theramore. It is garrisoned by human Theramore guards who watch the roads and keep order in the northern reaches of Dustwallow Marsh.

faq.q: Why is North Point Tower so isolated?
faq.answer: North Point became Theramore's furthest outpost after the garrison at Lost Point succumbed to desertion. With Lost Point lost to mutineers, the soldiers at North Point must hold the northern perimeter on their own.

faq.q: What threats do the guards face here?
faq.answer: The garrison contends with fierce swamp raptors, hostile Grimtotem tauren prowling the marsh, and the nearby Horde presence out of Brackenwall Village.

faq.q: Where does the road past the tower lead?
faq.answer: The road runs through northern Dustwallow Marsh, connecting eastward toward Theramore Isle, west toward the Barrens, and south deeper into the swamplands toward Tabetha's Farm.

angles.text: For travelers heading out from Theramore Isle into the deadly swamp, North Point Tower provides a rare and welcoming beacon of friendly steel along the marsh road.
The tower represents Theramore's military expansion deep into the marsh, sitting uncomfortably close to Brackenwall Village and the Barrens border.
